observation: Corrected committed-defect fixture; all four machine checks and independent review passed.
Broad redundant reconnaissance produced no plan; prompted runtime ceiling and bounded Planner tools.

Rejected false-negative research: exact API catalogs were checked, but the official GPT-5.6 family announcement documenting Sol, Terra, Luna and benchmarks was missed. Routing derived from this report is invalidated.
Decision-grade family research with dated direct API, OpenRouter, Codex subscription and enterprise-credit economics; Luna independent quality remains unknown.
Four-part implementation brief caused broad baseline reconnaissance; closeout arrived before edits. Split independent slices instead of raising the ceiling.
Even a narrowed CLI slice spent its budget on baseline inspection and made no edits; role prompt needs stronger edit-before-broad-validation guidance.
Durable resume preserved analysis and produced actionable verdict, but rejected closeout tools consumed model turns until the original 12-turn hard limit; reserve policy requires calibration.
Luna completed the bounded fix for $0.00380988; independent Terra mutation review approved but cost $0.0312032, 8.2x the coder. Review routing dominates trivial accepted-result cost.

Manual transitions plan→code→review→done. First Planner attempt paused at 12 model turns and was absent from terminal metrics; resume repeated reconnaissance. Corrected scorer accepts a private shared pure parser, matching the task rather than requiring an unrequested export.

Luna found both seeded blockers and avoided the false positive. Four early read failures show path-discovery waste. The benchmark scorer was corrected to accept equivalent stable codes rather than a hidden exact vocabulary.

Original scorer passed 5/5, but Terra found negative and NaN constructor-capacity holes. Two-round ceiling ended before the second issue could be repaired. Planner underestimated the labelled complex task as medium.

Continuation closed malformed constructor capacity, passed strengthened 6/6 scorer, and Terra approved with mutation and adversarial checks. Combined accepted-result cost from initial start was $0.83711116. Planner again rated the complex corpus task medium.
No plan after broad reconnaissance; cumulative input exceeded 500k. The model/tool reserve did not protect the input boundary.
Three cumulative attempts produced only a resolver and type skeleton. Resume avoided repeated reconnaissance, but context-heavy turns repeatedly overshot input ceilings.
Implemented the production wiring after resume but exhausted cumulative input before integration characterization and closeout.
Cheap but ineffective for a localized characterization-test slice under the current Coder prompt; made no edits before 14/14 turns.

Shipped brief is now composed only for explicit inventory research, provenance is durable and secret-free, missing briefs fail before dispatch, 458-test baseline plus two integration tests passed, and Terra approved. High accepted-result cost was dominated by repeated input-limit overshoots and tool-loop closeout failures.

With a 60k input reserve under a 180k hard ceiling and three reserved model turns, the Reviewer reached APPROVED instead of pausing at the hard input boundary. Repeated rejected batch calls remain a follow-up.

Three review passes exposed and fixed post-reserve tool loops, previous-request input prediction, durable lastInputTokens restoration, and a conservative legacy checkpoint fallback; final Terra review approved.

Four of four scorer gates passed after three rounds. Terra twice found tests that passed without independently failing against HEAD. Sol coding cost $0.4120 and did not reduce review rounds; retain Luna low for medium coding. Retry rounds reported projection_failure and expanded to full context.

Four of four scorer gates passed. All retry Coder and Reviewer stages stayed focused with no fallback despite an untracked regression-test file. This known-answer sample validates pipeline context transport only, not general model capability.

Four of four scorer gates passed. Orchestrator chose a $0.21419568 automatic pipeline, then duplicated tests, reads, and diff verification at an additional $0.06597000 orchestrator cost. Child progress exposed the workflow tool only as custom.
Luna passed five of five Python scorer checks in one round; Terra independently approved. Coder cost $0.00602932 and review cost $0.06290080, making review 91% of accepted-result cost.
Luna passed four of four Rust scorer checks in one round; Terra independently approved. Coder cost $0.00340524 and review cost $0.05863560, making review 95% of accepted-result cost.

Terra Planner correctly rated the cross-process lifecycle task complex. Two Sol rounds cost $2.251194 and failed closeout; Terra Coder produced more working integration per dollar. Four Terra reviews found stale reads, missing console delivery, unsafe projection, blocking subscribers, unrecoverable page limits, integration gaps, and docs failures. Final 482-test suite and 70-test mutation-backed focused suite passed. Route complex coding to Terra low; retain Sol for broad research.

A narrow PR review wandered for nine dispatches. SIGINT produced a durable interrupted pause and released the process. Checkpoint and ledger agree on input, tool turns, and reported cost; eight ledger responses settled, while the ninth dispatch was interrupted before a response.

Planner handed one persistence, pipeline-worker, and prompt-assembly slice. Coder read 14 files and made no edit before closeout. Task-shape-specific routing and decomposition failure: split cross-surface durable work before dispatch; stop and re-slice when the early budget has no edit evidence.

Narrow worker-only prompt-assembly slice produced resolver/orchestrator changes and integration coverage within the bound. Post-change gates and independent review remain pending, so this is implementation evidence, not an accepted-result sample.

Independent review verified role-scoped prompt isolation but found resolver file-symlink escape, absent bounded manifest discovery, and absent durable skill provenance. Split remediation into resolver safety, selection surface, and durable provenance slices; do not accept the prompt-assembly slice alone.

Focused review confirmed static symlink and limit coverage but found a TOCTOU escape: realpath validation and later pathname reads are separately raceable. Require descriptor-pinned no-follow reads before accepting resolver hardening.
Focused final review approved tagged fixed-width framing over original source, manifest, and instruction bytes after the preceding review exposed a UTF-8 decoding collision.

Planner used explore_project.focus as a natural-language topic because the tool contract did not identify it as a relative directory path; reconnaissance failed target_not_found and the pipeline paused. Clarify schema and prompt semantics.

After clarifying explore_project.focus and restoring Planner's focused read fallback, Orchestrator completed plan-code-review autonomously on a fresh project; focused regression tests passed and Reviewer approved in one round.

Terra/medium Orchestrator correctly invoked run_pipeline for a real detached-console repair. Sol Planner performed reconnaissance but emitted a JSON plan as text rather than the required submit_plan tool call; pipeline returned missing_plan and no stage transition was persisted. Do not repeat this cell before addressing planner tool-call adherence or changing the Planner route.

Terra completed a bounded design/reconnaissance run with an actionable sparse per-role stage-limit plan. The resulting implementation keeps controller enforcement policy-agnostic and overlays only at workflow dispatch. This is a design sample, not a route-quality comparison.

Terra scoped the real web-ceilings task with five searches but did not submit a plan before the deliberately fixed 180-second stage deadline. This is negative budget calibration evidence only; do not change Planner routing from one limit-hit sample.

After two text-only tool-handoff failures, the portable whole-JSON fallback accepted and strictly validated a live Codex OAuth Planner response. The pipeline exposed medium/none plan signals and paused before Coder on research_required; no implementation was dispatched. This validates structured handoff compatibility, not route quality.

The severity fallback is honoured; the unnameable codes are a real instruction-following miss, not a scorer artifact.

The role completed its review and was then discarded by the after_response usage guard: three of twelve turns reported reasoning above output (922>902, 1374>1306, 1656>1472), which the harness treats as a fatal RangeError rethrown after the work finished and the tokens were paid. This is harness evidence, not a routing signal for MiniMax M3: the provider reports reasoning outside completion_tokens while the guard assumes the OpenAI convention that includes it. Durable record for the BACKLOG entry on usage-counter discrepancy; do not change Reviewer routing from this run, because no review quality was observed.
